import type { ComponentType, SVGProps } from 'react'

  ArrowDown,

  Save,

  Send,

  Shield,
  ShieldCheck,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  Smartphone,
  SquarePen,
  Star,
  Strikethrough,
  Sun,
  Table,
  Tag,
  Trash2,
  TrendingDown,
  TrendingUp,
  TriangleAlert,
  Underline,
  Undo2,
  Upload,
  User,
  Users,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react'

/**
 * Server-side descriptors name icons with Lucide kebab-case identifiers. Unknown
 * names render nothing so a typo never breaks a page.
 */
const iconMap: Record<string, ComponentType<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>>> = {
  'activity': Activity,
  'alert-circle': CircleAlert,
  'alert-triangle': TriangleAlert,
  'arrow-down': ArrowDown,
  'arrow-down-right': ArrowDownRight,
  'arrow-left': ArrowLeft,
  'arrow-right': ArrowRight,
  'arrow-up': ArrowUp,
  'arrow-up-down': ArrowUpDown,
  'arrow-up-right': ArrowUpRight,
  'at-sign': AtSign,
  'bar-chart': ChartColumn,
  'bell': Bell,
  'bell-off': BellOff,
  'bold': Bold,
  'building': Building,
  'calendar': Calendar,
  'chart-column': ChartColumn,
  'check': Check,
  'check-check': CheckCheck,
  'check-circle': CircleCheck,
  'chevron-down': ChevronDown,
  'chevron-left': ChevronLeft,
  'chevron-right': ChevronRight,
  'chevron-up': ChevronUp,
  'chevrons-left': ChevronsLeft,
  'chevrons-right': ChevronsRight,
  'chevrons-up-down': ChevronsUpDown,
  'circle-alert': CircleAlert,
  'circle-check': CircleCheck,
  'circle-dot': CircleDot,
  'circle-help': CircleHelp,
  'circle-x': CircleX,
  'clipboard': Clipboard,
  'clock': Clock,
  'code': Code,
  'columns': Columns3,
  'columns-3': Columns3,
  'command': Command,
  'copy': Copy,
  'corner-down-left': CornerDownLeft,
  'download': Download,
  'ellipsis-vertical': EllipsisVertical,
  'external-link': ExternalLink,
  'eye': Eye,
  'eye-off': EyeOff,
  'file': File,
  'file-text': FileText,
  'filter': Filter,
  'fingerprint': FingerprintPattern,
  'folder': Folder,
  'globe': Globe,
  'grip-vertical': GripVertical,
  'hash': Hash,
  'heading': Heading,
  'home': Home,
  'image': Image,
  'inbox': Inbox,
  'info': Info,
  'italic': Italic,
  'key-round': KeyRound,
  'layers': Layers,
  'layout-dashboard': LayoutDashboard,
  'layout-grid': LayoutGrid,
  'link': Link,
  'list': List,
  'list-filter': ListFilter,
  'list-ordered': ListOrdered,
  'loader-circle': LoaderCircle,
  'lock': Lock,
  'log-in': LogIn,
  'log-out': LogOut,
  'mail': Mail,
  'menu': Menu,
  'minus': Minus,
  'monitor': Monitor,
  'moon': Moon,
  'more-horizontal': MoreHorizontal,
  'more-vertical': EllipsisVertical,
  'newspaper': Newspaper,
  'palette': Palette,
  'panel-left-close': PanelLeftClose,
  'panel-left-open': PanelLeftOpen,
  'paperclip': Paperclip,
  'pencil': Pencil,
  'plus': Plus,
  'quote': Quote,
  'refresh-cw': RefreshCw,
  'rotate-ccw': RotateCcw,
  'save': Save,
  'search': Search,
  'send': Send,
  'settings': Settings,
  'shield': Shield,
  'shield-check': ShieldCheck,
  'sliders-horizontal': SlidersHorizontal,
  'smartphone': Smartphone,
  'square-pen': SquarePen,
  'star': Star,
  'strikethrough': Strikethrough,
  'sun': Sun,
  'table': Table,
  'tag': Tag,
  'trash-2': Trash2,
  'trending-down': TrendingDown,
  'trending-up': TrendingUp,
  'triangle-alert': TriangleAlert,
  'underline': Underline,
  'undo-2': Undo2,
  'upload': Upload,
  'user': User,
  'users': Users,
  'x': X,
}

export function Icon({ name, ...props }: SVGProps<SVGSVGElement> & { name?: string }) {
  const IconComponent = name ? iconMap[name] : undefined
  if (!IconComponent) return null
  return <IconComponent aria-hidden="true" {...props} />
}
